title: IThink collaborative journey
content: Chad's early portfolio journey includes forming IThink, participating in Hackfest, developing Project Alitaptap for Technofusion 2026, connecting with Accenture professionals through the GDG Campus Loyola Hackfest coaching program, and building GInsights for ImaGnation 2026. The Globe Launchpad Student Grants Pitch 2026 entry secured second place. These are early-career collaborative and competition experiences, not employer roles.
